device.description: 10-bit dual-channel voltage-output DAC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: dac102s085.pdf (SNAS364F) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6-7 timing (Figure 2), p.14 power-on reset, p.15 power-down modes (Table 1) and serial interface, p.16 input shift register (Figure 32), p.17 68HC11 interface (CPOL 0, CPHA 1)

registers.name: PWR
registers.note: internal: power-down state (all outputs) and termination code A1:A0 (Table 1)

commands.name: Write register and update outputs
commands.note: OP1:OP0 = 01: the datasheet updates the outputs of all channels

commands.name: Write all registers and update outputs

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.6-7 (timing), p.14 (power-on reset), p.15 (power-down, serial interface), p.16 (Figure 32 input register: 0 A0 OP1 OP0 D9..D0 X X), p.17 (68HC11 CPOL/CPHA)
notModeled: analog outputs, VREFIN, power-down output terminations and wake-up time
leaving power-down: the datasheet only says a write sequence recovers; the model clears PWR.PD on any write command
the command executes on the 16th SCLK falling edge (commit now); SYNC rising earlier aborts it; bits after the 16th are ignored
SCLK and SYNC timing limits; operating temperature -40 to 105 C
variants: DAC082S085 (8-bit) and DAC122S085 (12-bit) are pin-compatible (separate datasheets); the WSON (DSC) package in the datasheet has no orderable part in the skeleton
